_note: DEMO DATA. Estimated buyer-paid fees for Amazon Hub delivery between two people: the seller drops the item at a Hub Counter or Locker in their area, Amazon carries it to a Hub Locker in the buyer's area, and the buyer collects it with a pickup code. Amazon Shipping lists counter drop-off with no pickup fee and same-day collection before 2 p.m. (shipping.amazon.com/locations). Production reads live rates from the Amazon Shipping API.

same_area.eta: same day if dropped off by 2 p.m.
